provisional_qualifications: The native tank state is tankA represented as one horizontal tank with two branches; the actual apparatus has two independent tanks and four outlets.
Legacy preview branch centerlines are x-only mapped to the compact x=4.8 m candidate; y/z are retained. Geometry dimensions and routing are provisional, not measurements.
The model assumes an effective valve plane at x=2.25 m, Cd=0.7, 1 s smoothstep opening, and minimum effective opening 0.02.
Tank headspace is modeled as sealed air at 1.2 MPa absolute, 293.15 K, with polytropic exponent set to the thermophysical air gamma; actual pressure convention and gas composition remain uncertain.

Downstream branches start with ambient air; the moving-front calculation holds front pressure at ambient and does not solve compressible gas flow. Omitted dry-path minor-loss K makes its air validity screen incomplete.
The 1-D full-bore front model omits stratification, pockets, water hammer, valve disk geometry, and gas ingestion at the intake crown. It is exploratory, not hardware validation.
purpose: Small frozen input packet for the exploratory initially-air moving-front reference driver.
runtime_dependency_note: The driver reads this packaged inputs directory only. The historical results/runs paths below record provenance; they are not required to run the driver.
